errors.text: The proposed SPD-and-annealing route does not reconstruct the powder-based high-energy ball milling and spark-plasma-sintering route or its critical processing window.

The falsification experiment tests thermal stability but does not distinguish Hall-Petch/dislocation strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening; it lacks grain-size-controlled or composition-controlled comparators.

No cited evidence directly establishes that the proposed Al0.35CoCrFeNi composition will retain an intermetallic-free FCC+BCC structure at grain sizes below 50 nm after the specified SPD and annealing treatment.
The claim of retained ductility is unsupported and differs from the target behavior, which retained limited ductility and intergranular fracture despite high strength.
